text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're speaking to the promising
new
talent, Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us what your future goals
are?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whoa!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her debut race over, she's
surrounded in an
instant by reporters.
Her dramatic announcement
triggers a
wave of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful goal! And we'd just
love to hear
which race you plan to
enter next!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My next race? Hm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The Fantasy Stakes.
choice_data_list: （まだ相談はしていないはずだけど……）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess she's already made her mind up.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I see! Might I ask if there's a reason you
chose
that race?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because the name sounds lovely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become a mascot, so
loveliness is
vital.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you still call udon "udon" if it
didn't have
any noodles?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Um... Sorry? Udon?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a productive day for Aston Machan,
who
makes a strong impression during
both her race
and her conference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During her race in particular, the eyes of
every
spectator were fixed on her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you know that Aston Machan—her
pace is
incredible, huh? What's that
running style called
again? Short stride?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You mean the one who had the big smile
on her
face when she was in the starting
gate? Yeah. She
looks so eager when
she runs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming a super ultra
mascot is a
long one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I don't start making the most of every
avenue
available to me now, I'll run out
of time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said that she wants to do everything
she
possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the reality is, I haven't been reliable
enough
for her. Even just before this
race, I was no help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides training, I wonder if there's
anything more
I could do to help her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I jot down some ideas in my notebook.
Media
coverage requests, social media
posts, fan
meets...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no point just doing the same
things as
everyone else. If we're going to
make a real
impact, we need to actually
stand out. What we
need to do is...
choice_data_list: いや、もう少し突飛でなければ……！
choice_data_list_en: No, it needs to be a bit more outlandish...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that a handmade Machan doll?
Th-thank
you... It's really beautifully
made.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...But why did you make this? Did
Machan ask you
to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go for a stroll and give out more
handmade
Machan dolls.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I was wonderin' what the heck I
was lookin'
at but... that's someone
dressed up in a Machan
mascot suit!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Why would someone get in a costume

like—huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is that... Machan's trainer?! What's goin'
on here?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do a lap of the town wearing a Machan
mascot
suit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Conk... Conk...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So this is Aston Machan, is it? Well, it's a
terrific
statue.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...But all the same, would you mind
coming to the
director's office for a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bronze statue of Aston Machan that
I made is
later removed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While fretting that I may have gone a bit

overboard, I decide to tell Aston
Machan about
what I've been up to.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What a great effort!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You deserve an ultra standing ovation
for all that
hard work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I'd like you to come with
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the demon fortress and see if
we can't
convince some demons to help
us.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
Well... at this point in time, I'm afraid it
would be
quite an ask to make official
mascot dolls of you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... it's a no?
choice_data_list_en: ï¼The URA Planning and Production Department...!?ï¼

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
As you're aware, our policy is to work
with
Umamusume who have outstanding
achievements
to their name, or those
that have attained
notable popularity.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's not to say that you're
lacking in
charm, Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
But you've only just debuted, and even
if we push
you through, there's a chance
people will think
you've been given an
unfair advantage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see... I wouldn't want an unfair
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I'll come back and try
again!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I need to make a name for myself fairly.
And to
do that, I'll need undeniable
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, my first goal should be to do well in
the
Fantasy Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then, after that, I can keep racking up
the
achievements. I'll stack up a whole
tower of
successes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I can do that, then someday, the URA
will turn
me into a mascot!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I will win it for sure! Humph.
choice_data_list_en: First, let's give it our all for that first win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want us to ride this momentum all the
way to the
Fantasy Stakes. After that,
we can take on the
Triple Tiara.
